name: PIE
recent: P.I.E. Industrial 于2026年11月20日宣布获得价值9982万美元的AI服务器订单，但表示对盈利贡献极小。公司2026财年第三季度（截至9月30日）净利环比大幅增长至1153万令吉，推动股价上涨。同期，主要股东Pan-International Industrial Corporation和Pan Global Holding Co. Ltd.在10月至11月间有股权变动申报。
notable: 获得价值9982万美元的AI服务器订单，但预计对盈利贡献极小。
2026财年第三季度净利环比增至1153万令吉。
主要股东Pan-International Industrial Corporation和Pan Global Holding Co. Ltd.在10月至11月间有股权变动。
risks: AI服务器订单对盈利贡献预计极小。
2026财年第三季度营收同比下滑22.0%，净利同比下滑40.2%。
earnings: 2026财年第三季度（截至9月30日）营收为1.801亿令吉，环比增长26.4%，但同比下滑22.0%；净利为380.7万令吉，环比扭亏（上季净亏损），但同比下滑40.2%，净利率为2.1%。

recent_en: P.I.E. Industrial announced on 20 Nov 2026 a US$99.82 million AI server order but expects minimal earnings contribution. Its 3QFY2026 (ended 30 Sep) net profit rose sharply to RM11.53 million, lifting its share price. Meanwhile, substantial shareholders Pan-International Industrial Corporation and Pan Global Holding Co. Ltd. filed changes in their interests in October and November.
notable_en: Secured a US$99.82 million AI server order, expected to have minimal earnings contribution.
3QFY2026 net profit rose to RM11.53 million quarter-on-quarter.
Substantial shareholders Pan-International Industrial Corporation and Pan Global Holding Co. Ltd. had changes in their interests in October and November.
risks_en: The AI server order is expected to have minimal earnings contribution.
3QFY2026 revenue fell 22.0% year-on-year and net profit fell 40.2% year-on-year.
earnings_en: 3QFY2026 (ended 30 Sep) revenue was RM180.1 million, up 26.4% quarter-on-quarter but down 22.0% year-on-year; net profit was RM3.807 million, a turnaround from the previous quarter's net loss but down 40.2% year-on-year, with a net margin of 2.1%.
